Job description:
Required skills: - Mastery of Python/Django - Mastery of DRF, FastAPI - Familiarity with Git - Familiarity with Linux operating system - Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases - Sufficient knowledge of Object-Oriented concepts, modular design - Familiarity with Database Locking, Concurrency, and Transaction Management. Qualifications: - Teamwork and high learning aptitude - Problem-solving ability - Ability to effectively use (AI) to increase the quality and speed of software development. Current programming level is not a top priority for us. What is more important to us is having an *Ownership* mindset, responsibility, following issues to the end result, the ability to continuous learning, and effective participation in product development. If you have a drive for growth and pursue work until the end result, we would be happy to get to know you.

Company description:
Smart Commerce Hamarz focuses on developing technological infrastructure and linking with modern financial tools to simplify and smarten the user experience in the areas of wealth management and credit scoring. Relying on technology, data, and an understanding of the audience's financial behavior, this collection designs solutions that make daily financial decisions faster, clearer, and more practical. In this approach, credit and investment are defined not as complex and inaccessible processes, but as tools serving users' financial lifestyles; tools that can facilitate access to financial resources, liquidity management, and the path to wealth creation for a diverse range of audiences.
